ambiguities_or_notes: Exact audited Russian Markdown source bytes were revalidated in this runtime against the pinned SHA-256.

The French original is translated directly, followed by the source's complete Russian editorial rendering in the same sequence; both page markers, publication note, and all seven preserved footnote definitions are represented.

descente is rendered hernia in accordance with the editors' Russian грыжа; varicoselle/varicosella is retained as varicocele in the direct translation and as the source's Latinized varicosella in the editorial rendering.

The bare numeral 5 after Basile is preserved. The official volume identifies it as a note to Vasily Stepanovich Perfiliev, but that original note is absent from the audited Markdown because [^5]–[^7] have been assigned to the duplicated Russian rendering; the missing note is documented rather than imported.
The repeated farewell and seal/watch expense passage is intentionally represented twice because the source preserves both the French original and its editorial Russian rendering.
